import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentSectionsRestriction

/-!
# Quasicoherent restriction on affine charts

The affine-open restriction needed by descent is local on a basic-open chart.
This file records the native section map itself, with an explicit chart
equation, so downstream descent code can use `IsBaseChange` without replacing
the restriction map by an abstractly chosen isomorphism.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

variable {R : CommRingCat.{u}}

/-- On an affine spectrum, restriction to an affine open presented as a basic
open is a genuine base-change map on quasicoherent sections. -/
theorem quasicoherent_affineOpenRestriction_isBaseChange
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {V : (Spec R).Opens} (f : R)
    (e : V = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :
    IsBaseChange Γ(Spec R, V)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (show V ≤ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens) by simp)) := by
  subst e
  exact quasicoherent_basicOpenRestriction_isBaseChange F f

/-- The same chart-level comparison is bijective in the literal
`moduleBaseChangeMap` form consumed by invariant-module descent. -/
theorem quasicoherent_affineOpenRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {V : (Spec R).Opens} (f : R)
    (e : V = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :
    Function.Bijective (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      R Γ(Spec R, V) Γ(F, ⊤) Γ(F, V)
      (affineSectionsRestrictionMap F
        (show V ≤ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens) by simp))) := by
  subst e
  exact quasicoherent_basicOpenRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective F f

end MilneLib
